items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: We had a fellow named Alex Davis who was a vocalist with us for a while. And he went to Lake Tahoe with us.

ctx.x: At times we did. We had a fellow named Alex Davis who was a vocalist with us for a while. And he went to Lake Tahoe with us. You see, I really didn't know anything in those days about the sociology of people or anything like that. Since then sometimes I've talked to Anita about it because it turns out that so many of those men, now I realise, whose parents somewhere were from Africa.
You know, they had African in them. But they were all, you know Irish. Ned Riggs brother for example, he had a rather classic African head. You know, the narrow kind of shape like that.
